evidence_quote: If you're interested in joining a dynamic and vibrant group of engineers, drafters, and consultants, send us an email with your CV attached. While we may not necessarily have positions currently available, we welcome all applicants and will keep your information on file for future roles.
employer_line: Costin Roe Consulting runs in-house civil and structural drafting teams in Sydney and sponsors drafting trainees through a TAFE Engineering Drafting diploma with mentoring from senior CAD draftspeople.
